description: Don Athukoralage Indrasiri v. Hon. Attorney General Don Athukoralage Indrasiri v. Hon. Attorney General View More before Hon. W.L. Ranjith Silva, J.
parties: Don Athukoralage Indrasiri v. Hon. Attorney General Don Athukoralage Indrasiri v. Hon. Attorney General View More
keywords: The Appellant challenged his conviction and death sentence for the murder of his wife, contending that the trial judge had misdirected himself in evaluating the circumstantial evidence and delayed pronouncing judgement. Held - Seeing no reason to interfere, Appeal dismissed.
legistation: Section 331 of the Code of Criminal Procedure Act No. 15 of 1979
